matrix_semantics.active_service_readiness: requires owner_issue evidence or explicit blocked/non-action result
matrix_semantics.slice_progress: controller progress ledger; does not replace per-issue evidence or accepted package reports

slice_progress.current_slice_field_note: current_slice identifies the initial Context7 single-service slice used to open #247 decomposition; it is not the live controller queue pointer after later slices are accepted.
slice_progress.ordering_reason: After context7, mentality, openzeppelin-solidity-contracts, ssh-tmux, and playwright, exa-search is the narrowest remaining credential-scoped service; it should be handled before broader GitHub mutation-capable and multi-provider web-search surfaces, while Serena remains later because project-scoped provisioning and language state are more dependent.

not_service_options.label: None
not_service_options.readiness_rule: Record decline, defer, or skip choice only; do not create service binding, backend, gateway, validation probe, or project service record.

services.instantiation_path: Bind project-local client state/config to existing ContextForge virtual server context7_local_server; do not create per-project backend, gateway, bridge, port, service unit, or server-instance directory.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Project state records the selected service so the global Pi shim can import the existing ContextForge virtual server.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: Project-local opencode.json records the selected MCP binding while the user-home OpenCode bootstrap plugin remains separate.
blockers_or_non_actions: no user-global client config mutation
no ContextForge registry or catalog mutation
no backend install or restart
no secret or token material write
dev-only CONTEXT7_API_KEY may live only in ignored local env files after explicit operator approval; do not print or commit it

services.instantiation_path: Bind only after provider credential, quota, cost, and redaction boundaries are explicit.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi may import the selected ContextForge service after project state binding, but runtime proof remains conditional.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode may bind the selected MCP entry after project-local apply, but runtime proof remains conditional.

safe_probe.arguments: bounded low-cost harmless query after credential approval

blockers_or_non_actions: do not write or expose API keys
do not run broad internet probes
do not claim readiness from provider availability alone

services.instantiation_path: Bind only with explicit GitHub account/token boundary and read-only proof semantics.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi visibility is a selected service binding plus read-only GitHub tool proof when credentials are scoped.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode visibility is a selected project-local MCP binding plus read-only GitHub tool proof when credentials are scoped.

safe_probe.arguments: viewer, rate-limit, repository, or issue metadata readback

blockers_or_non_actions: no issue, PR, comment, label, branch, or repository mutation
no token material in records
do not use local gh auth alone as target-client proof

services.instantiation_path: Reuse repo-local governance MCP behavior through ContextForge binding; do not duplicate governance state.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi can expose read-only governance list/read tools after project state binding.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode can expose read-only governance list/read tools after project-local config binding.
blockers_or_non_actions: no DECISIONS.md, ABEYANT_INTENTIONS.md, or OPEN_QUESTIONS.md mutation
do not treat local file reads as target-client proof

services.instantiation_path: Bind to the existing remote native ContextForge service; do not create local project or deployment state.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi can expose the selected remote template service after project state binding.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode can expose the selected remote template service after project-local config binding.

safe_probe.arguments: fixed harmless ERC-20 preview payload from the safe probe catalog

blockers_or_non_actions: no deployment, wallet, RPC, private-key, or project file write
do not make security or audit claims from generated code

services.instantiation_path: Bind to an isolated browser runtime only under controlled fixture-page validation.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi can expose Playwright tools after project state binding, but safe proof needs a controlled fixture page.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode can expose Playwright tools after project-local config binding, but safe proof needs a controlled fixture page.
blockers_or_non_actions: no arbitrary browsing
no unsafe code execution
no screenshots of unknown pages
no host browser/global config mutation

services.instantiation_path: Bind existing session visibility only; do not open sessions or send commands during ordinary validation.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi can expose read-only session listing after project state binding when a safe session boundary exists.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode can expose read-only session listing after project-local config binding when a safe session boundary exists.
blockers_or_non_actions: no opening sessions
no command or key sending
no remote file mutation
no cleanup or close operations

services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi may import the selected ContextForge service after project state binding, but runtime proof remains conditional.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode may bind the selected MCP entry after project-local apply, but runtime proof remains conditional.

services.instantiation_path: Bind only to an approved project-scoped Serena instance; provisioning, language choice, and LSP state remain explicit boundaries.
services.pi_visibility_expectation: Pi can expose the selected project Serena service only after project instance readiness and project state binding.
services.opencode_visibility_expectation: OpenCode can expose the selected project Serena service only after project instance readiness and project-local config binding.

safe_probe.tool_name_hint: Serena read-only status or language/profile metadata

blockers_or_non_actions: no Serena provisioning in this taxonomy/matrix slice
no LSP writes
no global config mutation
no broad project scan as validation proof
